digest.component_or_area: LLM model selection and fallback handling
propositions: A class without a fallback array constructs a plain model with no FallbackModel wrapper, preserving existing behaviour
A class with a fallback array constructs a FallbackModel whose default is the primary entry and fallbacks are inline model configs with full endpoint support
An error classified as RETRY_NOW or WAIT_AND_RETRY or CHANGE_PROVIDER_OR_MODEL triggers fallback selection; errors outside this set propagate without failover

Capabilities are computed as the conservative intersection over all candidate models (primary and fallbacks) before the wrapper is built, and capabilities_for is never called on the FallbackModel itself
A fallback entry with an endpoint override produces a model built against that endpoint, not the provider default, and all fallback clients register on the same ProviderSession and close exactly once

The ran_model field in provider_provenance is read from ModelResponse.model_name (the actual respondent), not from FallbackModel.model_name (a synthetic fallback:... string), so verdicts accurately attest which candidate answered
